item.address: 604/38 Cumberland Street, The Rocks NSW 2000, NSW 2000
item.description:
Discover a life of effortless luxury at the brand new 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom, 2-car SIRIUS Residence 604, one of the collection's finest.

Set against the enchanting backdrop of The Rocks, which captures the essence of Sydney's past and promising present, this residence is a one-of-a-kind home where the Opera House and Harbour Bridge are prominently featured.

Designed by visionaries Kelly Hoppen Interiors, BVN Architecture, and Richard Crookes Constructions, Residence 604 is a beautiful symphony of space and light. Residents with a passion for entertaining will fall in love with the high-end Wolf and Sub-Zero chef's kitchen and grand living area for social occasions. At the end of the evening, retreat to one of the three beautifully crafted bedrooms, each with an ensuite featuring sculpted marble, international designer tapware, and heated floors. With the addition of a private dressing room and beautifully crafted bathtub, the decadent main suite encapsulates heightened comfort.

With floor-to-ceiling double-glazed glass, you have a front-row seat to Sydney's most spectacular sunrises, sunsets, and dazzling firework displays. Rich marble and warm timber finishes create an interior that is both refined and inviting, allowing residents to live life on a more luxurious scale.

2025 CTBUH Awards, Best International Tall Building by Height (under 100m)
2025 Australian Institute of Architects (AIA) NSW State Awards, Residential Architecture - Multiple Housing
